name: HC35a: Total
description:
Number of active ART clients whose latest valid viral load at the time of CD4 testing was non-suppressed and who had a completed CD4 count during the reporting period.
A numeric CD4 COUNT result must occur during the reporting period. The patient's latest valid VL on or before the CD4 result date must be non-suppressed, and the patient must be active on ART.

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT r.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_test_orders_results r
WHERE r.patient_id IS NOT NULL

  AND UPPER(TRIM(r.test_parameter)) = 'CD4 COUNT'

  AND r.encounter_datetime >= :startDate
  AND r.encounter_datetime < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
  AND TRIM(r.test_value) REGEXP '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v
      WHERE v.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND v.result_status = 'VALID'
        AND v.is_unsuppressed = 1
        AND v.is_suppressed = 0

        AND COALESCE(
              v.sample_collection_date,
              v.viral_load_clinical_date,
              v.laboratory_result_date,
              v.order_date
            ) <= r.encounter_datetime

        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v2
            WHERE v2.patient_id = v.patient_id
              AND v2.result_status = 'VALID'

              AND COALESCE(
                    v2.sample_collection_date,
                    v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                    v2.laboratory_result_date,
                    v2.order_date
                  ) <= r.encounter_datetime

              AND (
                  COALESCE(
                      v2.sample_collection_date,
                      v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                      v2.laboratory_result_date,
                      v2.order_date
                  ) >
                  COALESCE(
                      v.sample_collection_date,
                      v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                      v.laboratory_result_date,
                      v.order_date
                  )
                  OR (
                      COALESCE(
                          v2.sample_collection_date,
                          v2.viral_load_clinical_date,
                          v2.laboratory_result_date,
                          v2.order_date
                      ) =
                      COALESCE(
                          v.sample_collection_date,
                          v.viral_load_clinical_date,
                          v.laboratory_result_date,
                          v.order_date
                      )
                      AND v2.episode_id > v.episode_id
                  )
              )
        )
  )

  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
      WHERE a.patient_id = r.patient_id
        AND (
            (
                a.encounter_date >= :startDate
                AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
            )
            OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
